54:     def forward(self, x):
55:         seq_len, _ = x.size()
56:         for i in range(self.num_layers):
57:             h = self.h_lins[i](x)
58:             k = F.sigmoid(self.k_lins[i](x)).view(seq_len, self.hidden_channels, self.heads)
59:             if self.qk_shared:
60:                 q = k
61:             else:
62:                 q = F.sigmoid(self.q_lins[i](x)).view(seq_len, self.hidden_channels, self.heads)
63:             v = self.v_lins[i](x).view(seq_len, self.hidden_channels, self.heads)
64: 
65:             # numerator
66:             kv = torch.einsum('ndh, nmh -> dmh', k, v)
67:             num = torch.einsum('ndh, dmh -> nmh', q, kv)
68: 
69:             # denominator
70:             k_sum = torch.einsum('ndh -> dh', k)
71:             den = torch.einsum('ndh, dh -> nh', q, k_sum).unsqueeze(1)
72: 
73:             # linear global attention based on kernel trick
74:             if self.beta < 0:
75:                 beta = F.sigmoid(self.betas[i]).unsqueeze(0)
76:             else:
77:                 beta = self.betas[i].unsqueeze(0)
78:             x = (num/den).reshape(seq_len, -1)
79:             x = self.lns[i](x) * (h+beta)
80:             x = F.relu(self.lin_out(x))
81:             x = F.dropout(x, p=self.dropout, training=self.training)
82:
